amendment_reason: The V13 preflight correctly refused the one-Hz-certified R4 bundle at 5 Hz. V14 uses the same M3+M4 weights and R4 structure with a conservative fivefold per-frame temporal covariance inflation. The global control grid is sparsified from 200 one-second controls to 100 two-second controls; ten 5 Hz opportunities are evaluated per step, preserving the 200 s physical horizon and requested observation cadence.
purpose: Select one hash-bound route per task and arm using the launch-resolved CasADi/L-BFGS-B expected-belief planner with a sparse two-second control grid, 1.0 m/s bounds, and 5 Hz camera-network opportunities.
evidence_role: Final route selection for the four-arm thesis navigation campaign after closing the omitted-prop collision geometry. No commissioning audit labels or scientific navigation outcomes are inputs.

C00.meaning: constant per-camera availability and constant per-camera covariance

C01.meaning: constant per-camera availability and commissioned spatial covariance

C10.meaning: commissioned Bernoulli-GP availability and constant per-camera covariance

C11.meaning: commissioned Bernoulli-GP availability and commissioned spatial covariance

nominal_route_prior.rationale: Fixed route-design prior shared by all arms; not estimated from final audit or runtime outcomes.

candidate_generation: Generate one deterministic set per task from lane-graph polylines, vertical traversable-rectangle centrelines, endpoint-lane variants, and combined start-and-goal lane-centre variants.

common_feasibility.definition: Static swept rectangular-body clearance is checked against both the driveable-lane union and the complete physical collision scene, including separately included props. Bounded-unicycle swept rollout and terminal-goal reachability at 1.0 m/s must also agree across all four arms.
common_feasibility.optimizer_transition_check: CasADi state costs sample constant-twist transitions at no more than 0.20 m; release admission independently checks the swept rectangular body at 0.04 m.

selection_rule: For each task, establish one common physically feasible candidate subset. Select the minimum exact expected-belief rollout cost separately for each arm, using candidate name only as an exact-cost tie break.
execution_design: Hash-bind each selected route, then execute matched seeds in Gazebo at 1.0 m/s with the same pure-pursuit controller, M3+M4 correction, temporally inflated R4 covariance, 5 Hz detector batches, and 5 Hz correction attempts.
final_audit_firewall: Final-audit labels, residuals, and outcomes do not enter candidate generation, feasibility, route scoring, or route selection. The observed v2 collision is used only to close the missing physical-geometry source.

runtime_estimator_contract.mean_chain: M3_box_mlp plus gated M4 16x16 visibility residual

temporal_dependence_limit.interpretation: The five within-second opportunities are the requested nominal conditional-independence planning approximation; the observed temporal residual dependence must be disclosed when interpreting belief calibration.

temporal_covariance_policy.information_interpretation: five successive frames contribute no more information than one uninflated commissioned frame
